title: Welcome to the Twenty Third Annual Hawaii International Conference on Education
extended_summary:
This document is the front matter and program booklet for the 2025 Hawaii International Conference on Education rather than an empirical study. It provides conference logistics, keynote information, and a schedule of sessions across many education topics, but does not present a single research question, intervention, or study with analyzable data.

Because no paper-specific empirical report is included in the provided text, there is no treatment, sample, or outcome evidence to extract for the user’s generative-AI question. The booklet does, however, show that the conference contains many workshop, descriptive, qualitative, and mixed-method presentations across teacher education, technology, literacy, and related fields. No evidence about generative AI lesson-plan generation or AI instructional coaching/lesson-plan feedback in K-12 teacher contexts is reported in the excerpt.
quality_tier_rationale: This is conference proceedings front matter and a session-program listing, not an empirical study of a technology intervention. No research design, sample, measures, or analytic methodology are reported for a paper evaluating generative AI lesson-plan generation or instructional coaching/feedback in K-12 contexts.
impact_tier_rationale: There is no evidence of an evaluated intervention or measurable educational impact in the provided text. The document only provides conference logistics and abstracts/descriptions of unrelated sessions.
